_note: What Hachiro says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; the gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction (gift_birthday on their birthday) (gifts in data/villagers/hachiro.json). Our own lines.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Birthday? Hm. At my age you stop counting and start mending. Still. Thanks.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: You came out in the cold with this, on the day. ...I won't forget it.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Mind the boards. A nail in the foot and you'll be no use to your turnips.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Cedar for the posts, pine for the floor. Your grandfather would've argued with me about the pine.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Don't hover. It goes up faster when nobody's watching it.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Something else? Talk while I work, then.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Ha. You like an old man's company, eh?

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Rain on the roof, fire in the forge. Not a bad day to be a smith.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Can't mend a roof in the wet. So I mend hoes instead.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: I took the sickle up to the grave. Left it a little crooked, the way you struck it. He'd want to see.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Kota asked why you get to touch the hammer and he doesn't. I said: grow calluses first.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: The forge burns better on days you come by. Don't ask me why. Fire has moods.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Your hoe sings when it hits the soil now. You've got the swing.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Bring it in once in a while. A good tool wants looking after.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Saved you a whetstone. No, no, keep your money. Use it.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Hachiro. I fix roofs, and I fix tools. Mostly roofs, these days.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: The old farm, eh? The fence by the gate leans. I'd see to it.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: River water's colder than the pond's. The fish in it fight like they've somewhere to be.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Steel cools in still water. A smith cools off in running water. ...My own saying. Just now.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Come fall the salmon push up past those rocks. Some nights you hear them slap the water.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Sunday. The anvil rests and so do I. The fish don't, though.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Quiet... Don't scare the koi. I've been waiting an hour for this one.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: The roof over Kota's house won't mend itself. Nails before tea.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Morning. Smithy opens at ten. Bring what's broken.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Evening's the best time at the pond. The water goes gold.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Hot as the forge out here. And I'd know.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Good time for an axe. The wood's drying, the stumps come up easy.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Steel is honest. Hit it right and it remembers.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: If the can leaks, don't hammer it yourself. Bring it here.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Kota was here asking for a fish hook again. That boy...

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Oh? Now that's a fine thing.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: You know how to warm a man's stomach. Thank you.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Hm. Not bad at all. Thank you kindly.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: For me? Well. Thank you.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Ah... sweet things aren't for me. Still, thank you.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Ugh. Can't stand the smell of it. Take it back, will you.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: One's enough for today. Don't spoil me.
